package fixture

import "notary/internal/mem0"

// Naming the unexported field e of mem0.CompleteEnumeration must not compile
// outside the package. CompleteEnumeration is the token the reconciler trusts
// to mean "this listing was proven exhaustive"; only GetAllComplete may set its
// one unexported field, so no caller can forge an exhaustive-looking listing
// (which would let the absence rule conclude a memory was removed from a short
// or absent read). The composite literal below names that field directly and
// the Go compiler must refuse it.
var _ = mem0.CompleteEnumeration{e: nil}
